note: File Rename adds a rename form/route for core file entities plus optional 'Rename' links on file-field widgets. Its only persistent state is (a) the config flag file_rename.settings:always_show_widget_link (boolean, shipped default 1) and (b) a per-widget third-party setting content.<field>.third_party_settings.file_rename.show_rename_link on an entity_form_display component (only offered on FileWidget/subclass widgets). No Drush, no plugins. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config: introspection reads the global flag and which file field's widget has the rename link; execution turns the global flag on and enables the per-widget setting, verified against live config. The rename form route is entity.file.rename_form and rename invokes hook_file_prerename/hook_file_rename; only permanent files are renamable.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site with the file_rename module, what permission must a user have to rename a managed file, and which config object/key turns on the inline 'Rename' link for all file field widgets at once?
evals.expected_output: Permission: 'rename files' (defined in file_rename.permissions.yml, restrict access). Global link: config object file_rename.settings, boolean key always_show_widget_link (default 1); enable at /admin/config/file_rename/settings or `drush config:set file_rename.settings always_show_widget_link 1`.

evals.prompt: With file_rename installed but the global setting off, how do I enable the 'Rename' link for just one file field, and where is that choice stored in configuration?
evals.expected_output: Open that field's Manage form display, open the file widget's settings, tick 'Show rename link', Update and Save. It is stored as a third-party setting on the widget component: core.entity_form_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field>.third_party_settings.file_rename.show_rename_link: true. The checkbox only appears on FileWidget (or subclass) widgets.

evals.prompt: In the file_rename module, which route/form is used to rename a file entity, and which hook fires immediately before the file is moved on disk (useful for flushing caches)?
evals.expected_output: Route entity.file.rename_form (path admin/content/files/rename/{file}) rendered by Drupal\file_rename\Form\FileRenameForm. On save the module invokes hook_file_prerename() before FileSystem::move() and hook_file_rename() after saving; file_rename's own file_prerename flushes image-style derivatives for images.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, is the file_rename option that shows the 'Rename' link on ALL file field widgets currently enabled? Inspect the live configuration and state the value of its flag.
evals.expected_output: It is currently OFF: file_rename.settings:always_show_widget_link is 0 (false). Read with `drush config:get file_rename.settings always_show_widget_link`.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has a file field whose upload widget is configured (via file_rename) to show a 'Rename' link, while the global setting is off. Inspect the live default form display for Article and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_fr_doc: in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default its file_generic widget component has third_party_settings.file_rename.show_rename_link: true.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a file field field_fr_task using the standard file (file_generic) widget, and file_rename's global link setting is off. Using file_rename, configure the default form display so this field's widget shows the 'Rename' link. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_fr_task component carries third_party_settings.file_rename.show_rename_link: true (tick 'Show rename link' on the widget in Manage form display, or set the component's third_party_settings and save).

evals.prompt: I want the 'Rename' link to appear on every file upload field across my whole site, without configuring each field individually. Turn on the file_rename setting that does this, and apply it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set file_rename.settings:always_show_widget_link to 1 (true) - via /admin/config/file_rename/settings ('Display "Rename" link on all file fields') or `drush config:set file_rename.settings always_show_widget_link 1`.
